#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    int left = 0;
    int result = 0;
    while (left < (int)str.length()) {
        int end = left + 1;
        while (end < (int)str.length() && str[left] == str[end]) {
            end++;
        }
        result += (end - left + 1) % 2;
        left = end;
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
